output.summary: formatPrice gains a required currency parameter and tax gains an optional rate parameter. Their callers are updated to pass the new argument. Several other edits (a legacy label, same-named methods, and a currency config value) look unrelated to those signature changes.

groups.title: formatPrice gains a currency parameter
groups.description: The signature now requires a currency and the output is prefixed with it. Check that the new output format is intended.

groups.title: formatPrice callers pass USD
groups.description: Checkout, invoice, receipt and the re-export caller now pass 'USD'. Check that USD is right for each, especially given config.json changes currency to EUR.

groups.title: tax gains an optional rate
groups.description: The rate is now a parameter defaulting to 0.1, so existing calls keep their behavior. Confirm the default preserves the old result.

groups.title: tax callers pass 0.2
groups.description: order_total and refund now pass a rate of 0.2 instead of the default 0.1. Check that this rate change is intended.

groups.title: Apparently unrelated edits
groups.description: These look unrelated to the signature changes: a legacy label using a different formatPrice, two calls to same-named methods, and the currency config switched to EUR. Check each is intended.

edgeVerdicts.reason: The call is on a Fmt instance, so it reaches the Fmt.formatPrice method, not the function in price.ts.
The call is on a Calc() instance, so it reaches the Calc.tax method, not the function in tax.py.
